author: Lucktheman
quote:
GTA6 took out so much of what made GTA GTA. There’s now a right or wrong way to do crime and if you do the wrong way you’re a bad person. You’re stuck doing house chores half the time and it feels more like the sims with mods than it does GTA.
There’s a bit that’s improved upon from the rest of the series like the police actually recognizing you and not just losing you after you park under a bridge, and other smaller nice things, but majority of the game is just riddled with dumb choices, glitches galore, and pandering nobody cares about. Just go play GTA5 and we’ll say this is Grand Theft Sims so we can still hope for GTA6 in the future.
